items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Johnny, you mentioned that one piece that you played first, that they played with Shilling at the ballpark... So, Shilling says, come on. I said, I ain't playing no other things... So, we walked... to the Tulane Theatre... after every talker, we had to play a little, little talker, little run music
